ideas.pitch: An AI-powered predictive platform for educational institutions that uses Poisson regression and risk-scoring models to forecast student dropout risks, academic stress spikes, and institutional safety incidents based on attendance and behavioral telemetry.
ideas.title: EduShield AI: Automated Student Vulnerability and Incident Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly aligns with the AI with Education theme while adopting the winning quantitative modeling and statistical forecasting approach seen in the Apart Research AI Forecasting hackathon win.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent graph-intelligence platform built for educational administrative boards to detect illicit fund routing, scholarship embezzlement, and grant allocation anomalies using explainable graph algorithms.
ideas.title: GraphEdu: Institutional AML and Grant Fraud Risk Detector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the powerful graph intelligence and explainability architecture that won the DIGITIMES AI Innovation Hackathon, applying it to educational finance and administrative accountability.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent AI student support system utilizing LangGraph and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to dynamically spin up specialized tutor agents targeting individual learning gaps identified during continuous assessments.
ideas.title: LearnGraph: Multi-Agent Personalized Remedial Tutor Network
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the multi-agent orchestration pattern that secured 1st place at the GreenNovation Hackathon, tailored specifically for student-centric pedagogical support under the Horizon theme.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered nutrition and wellness web application designed for campus dining halls that delivers personalized meal recommendations, tracks caloric macros via image recognition, and provides actionable student health insights.
ideas.title: NutriEd AI: Multimodal Dietary and Nutritional Guidance for Campuses
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly adapts the winning concept from the Mealzy 24-Hour Hackathon to solve student wellness and health challenges within educational ecosystems.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven platform for vocational and educational institutions to manage prospective student acquisition, analyze sentiment across community touchpoints, and build institutional trust through automated personalized engagement.
ideas.title: CampusTrust AI: Institutional Reputation and Student Acquisition Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Utilizes the high-converting patient acquisition and trust engine architecture that won 1st prize at the Elevate X sprint, pivoting the domain to educational enrollment pipelines.
